_note: Single source of truth for Riverkeepers rule numbers and table text. The spec (design/spec.md), the simulator and any printed sheet should read from here.

endings.title: The Drowned Valley
endings.when: No Town survives to the Future (game ends at setup, score 0).

endings.title: The River United
endings.when: Main Network crosses the river and links 5+ Towns.

endings.title: The Long Bridge
endings.when: Main Network crosses the river but links fewer than 5 Towns.

endings.title: Two Shores
endings.when: Main Network does not cross, but links 3+ Towns.

1.title: Good Harvest
1.text: Build one extra Settlement in any row (normal placement rules).

3.title: The Ferryman
3.text: Build one extra Bridge in any row that allows a Bridge.

4.title: Dry Summer
4.text: This turn, do not add the Water die to the Water Track.

6.title: Great Storm
6.text: A Flood happens now (roll a die for the row).

1.title: Traveling Mason
1.text: Draw a New Bridge on an open river cell whose C or E cell in the same row is part of your network. (This is the only way to build a bridge in the Future.)

2.title: Late Flood
2.text: Roll a die for the row. Plain road on C and E in that row turns to Marsh, unless that row has an Embankment.

5.title: Fog
5.text: This turn you have only 1 Step.

6.title: Founders' Road
6.text: Draw 1 free road cell next to any Town.
